article.title: Cision開放Brandwatch消費研究的AI接入
article.summary: Cision推出Cision Intelligence，首階段讓客戶經模型情境協定（MCP）在支援工具查詢Brandwatch消費研究資料。
highlights: 首版提供查詢管理、快速搜尋、摘要及提示。
其他產品與搜尋情報的整合仍屬計劃。
article.why: 公關團隊可比較日常AI工具與原有研究平台的查詢結果和資料範圍。
article.next_step: 取一條品牌監測查詢，比對結果的時間窗、樣本來源及摘要是否保留原意。
article.detail: Cision表示，首階段會透過Cision MCP連接Brandwatch Consumer Research的代理，讓客戶在支援工具中建立查詢、探索消費者討論、整理摘要及設定提示。接入是現有Brandwatch研究流程的另一個入口。使用摘要製作簡報前，可抽查原始討論和查詢條件。
article.title_en: Cision opens an AI connector to Brandwatch consumer research
article.summary_en: Cision launched Cision Intelligence, initially connecting Brandwatch Consumer Research to supported tools via Model Context Protocol, or MCP.
highlights_en: The first release supports query management, quick search, summaries and alerts.
Connections to search intelligence and other products remain planned.
article.why_en: PR teams can compare query results and data coverage between their AI tools and the research platform.
article.next_step_en: Compare one brand-monitoring query for time window, data sources and fidelity of the summary.
article.detail_en: Cision says its first release connects Brandwatch Consumer Research agents through Cision MCP. In supported tools, customers can build queries, explore consumer conversations, generate summaries and configure alerts. It provides another entry point to the existing research workflow. Check the original conversations and query settings before using summaries in a brief.
